backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for Roaf Agro Traders backend, implementing user profiles, a static business profile, a product catalog with CRUD and filtering, and order management with role-based access control via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the business address and contact number are displayed in Footer, BusinessProfilePage, and HomePage, with high confidence and linked to test REQ-2.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend file paths to short summaries describing the purpose and key implementation details of each admin and public page component.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Roaf Agro Traders' and mounting the app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster, renders the shared Layout with Header/Footer, and provides an AdminGuard for protected admin routes.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Site footer displaying brand info, quick navigation links, and a contact section with the real address 'Hangulgund Kokernag, near SBI Bank' and a clickable phone link '6006149326'.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Responsive site header with logo, navigation links, admin dropdown menu, and Internet Identity login/logout controls, including a mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/product/ProductC: Displays a single product's category, availability badge, name, description, and price in a card layout with optional action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to enter their name to complete profile setup, submitting via an onSave callback with loading and validation states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login, logout, and identity state across the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including products, inventory, orders, user profiles, and admin status.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and defining Tailwind CSS base layers with earthy green and amber CSS custom properties for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CreateOrderPage: Admin page for creating a new customer order by selecting products, setting quantities in a cart, and submitting via `useCreateOrder`. Calculates the total amount and navigates to the orders list on success.
frontend/src/pages/admin/InventoryManage: Admin page for managing inventory items with add, edit, and delete functionality using dialog and alert-dialog components. Displays inventory in a table with low-stock warnings and uses mutation hooks for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderDetailsPag: Admin page that displays full details of a single order (customer info, items, timestamps) fetched by ID, and allows updating the order status via a dropdown with toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page listing all orders in a filterable table by status (pending/completed/cancelled), with inline status update controls and navigation to individual order detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for managing the product catalog, supporting add, edit, and delete operations via dialogs/alerts with form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/BusinessProfilePage.t: Displays the business profile page for Roaf Agro Traders with a hero section, logo, and profile details fetched via `useGetBusinessProfile`. Shows loading skeletons, error states, and profile info including badges, contact, and description.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the public-facing home page with a hero section, featured products, and product category grid using data from `useGetBusinessProfile` and `useGetProductCatalog`. Includes navigation links to the catalog and about pages.
frontend/src/pages/ProductCatalogPage.ts: Displays a filterable, searchable product catalog page using `useGetProductCatalog`, with filters for category and availability. Renders products via `ProductCard` components and supports clearing all active filters.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read, persist, and clear URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme tokens (colors via OKLCH variables, fonts, border radii, shadows, keyframes) and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file describing the 'Roaf Agro Traders' agricultural e-commerce app, tracking existing features, pending feature requests, and architectural notes at schema version 1.0.0.
